TITLE: Final Fantasy Randomizer
DESC: Play Final Fantasy Randomizer (FF1) seeds with a tracker that follows the game: key items, orbs, vehicles.
BLURB: Roll a seed at finalfantasyrandomizer.com, play the ROM right here on the hub’s NES, and the tracker follows along: the 17 key items, the four orbs, ship, airship, bridge and canal, gold, and shards in Shard Hunt.
FINE: Seeds are made on the randomizer’s own site (it runs in your browser there too).
